# Lovecraftian Village 1.3 HDRP (not included)

This folder is a placeholder. The commercial **Lovecraftian Village 1.3 HDRP** asset pack is NOT part of this repository and must never be committed.

To use it locally:

1. Buy or open your licensed copy in the Unity Asset Store ("My Assets").
2. In Unity 6 open `Window > Package Manager > My Assets`, find the pack, then `Download` and `Import`.
3. Import to its default location (`Assets/Lovecraftian Village*`). Those folders are gitignored.
4. Open `Assets/Data/village_catalog.json` and map each catalog id to the prefab name you own.

Anything in this directory except this README is ignored by git.
